G'oya

Avval har bir kartani o'z bemoriga bog'laymiz: bemor kaliti LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) va birth_date, bemor "nomi" esa asosiy karta. Asosiy kartani FIRST_VALUE bilan topamiz. Keyin tashriflarni ulab, asosiy karta bo'yicha yig'amiz.

Yechim

WITH p AS (
  SELECT id, LOWER(TRIM(full_name)) AS nm, birth_date, registered_on
  FROM patients
),
g AS (
  SELECT id, FIRST_VALUE(id) OVER (PARTITION BY nm, birth_date ORDER BY registered_on, id) AS main_id
  FROM p
)
SELECT g.main_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS cards,
       COUNT(v.id) AS visits,
       MAX(v.visit_on) AS last_visit
FROM g
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.patient_id = g.id
GROUP BY g.main_id

g da har bir karta yonida uning asosiy kartasi turadi. LEFT JOIN tashrifi yo'q kartalarni ham saqlaydi: ularda v.id NULL, shuning uchun COUNT(v.id) 0 beradi, MAX esa NULL.

Tuzoqlar

Kartalarni COUNT(*) bilan sanash xato: LEFT JOIN dan keyin har karta tashriflari soncha qatorga ko'payadi. Ikki karta va besh tashrif cards = 5 beradi. COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) aynan shuning uchun.

Noto'g'riWITH g AS (
  SELECT id, FIRST_VALUE(id) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(full_name)), birth_date ORDER BY registered_on, id) AS main_id
  FROM patients
)
SELECT g.main_id, COUNT(*) AS cards, COUNT(v.id) AS visits, MAX(v.visit_on) AS last_visit
FROM g
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.patient_id = g.id
GROUP BY g.main_id

Tug'ilgan sanani kalitdan tushirib qoldirish ismdoshlarni bitta odamga aylantiradi. Poliklinikada bu shunchaki statistika xatosi emas: bir bemorning tahlillari boshqasining kartasida ko'rinadi.
